facts.statement: Verify the two-tank controller normal sequence, STOP/START resume behavior and controlled SHUT behavior in a 900 s simulation.
facts.quote:
Verify the two-tank controller normal sequence, STOP/START resume behavior and controlled SHUT
 behavior in a 900 s simulation.

facts.statement: T1 shall reach the effective high-level setpoint of 0.80 m before the first transfer begins.
facts.quote: AC-01 - T1 shall reach the effective high-level setpoint of 0.80 m before the first transfer begins.

facts.statement: All valves shall be closed throughout the STOP interval from 220 s until the START command at 280 s.
facts.quote: AC-02 - All valves shall be closed throughout the STOP interval from 220 s until the START command at 280 s.

facts.statement: The START at 280 s shall resume the interrupted transfer rather than restart filling.
facts.quote: AC-03 - The START at 280 s shall resume the interrupted transfer rather than restart filling.

facts.statement: Following completion of the first T2 drain, the controller shall automatically begin another fill cycle after the effective 8 s inter-cycle delay.
facts.quote:
AC-04 - Following completion of the first T2 drain, the controller shall automatically begin another fill cycle after the
       effective 8 s inter-cycle delay.

facts.statement: All valves shall be closed throughout the STOP interval from 650 s until SHUT at 700 s.
facts.quote: AC-05 - All valves shall be closed throughout the STOP interval from 650 s until SHUT at 700 s.

facts.statement: At 700 s V1 shall remain closed and V2/V3 shall be commanded open together for controlled draining.
facts.quote: AC-06 - At 700 s V1 shall remain closed and V2/V3 shall be commanded open together for controlled draining.

facts.statement: After shutdown drain completion the controller shall return to IDLE with all valves closed and shall remain there through 900 s because no subsequent START is scheduled.
facts.quote:
AC-07 - After shutdown drain completion the controller shall return to IDLE with all valves closed and shall remain
      there through 900 s because no subsequent START is scheduled.

facts.statement: Normal automatic operation shall never command V1 and V2 simultaneously, nor V2 and V3 simultaneously. The latter combination is permitted only in SHUTDOWN.
facts.quote:
AC-08 - Normal automatic operation shall never command V1 and V2 simultaneously, nor V2 and V3 simultaneously.
     The latter combination is permitted only in SHUTDOWN.

facts.statement: A tolerance of +/-2 s is acceptable for state-boundary comparisons when the effective parameter set is used.
facts.quote:
A tolerance of
 +/-2 s is acceptable for state-boundary comparisons when the effective parameter set is used.
